svg.title: A Common Scale
svg.desc: Two Met drawings are shown in windows scaled by one shared pixel-to-centimetre ratio, using the sheet dimensions in their collection records.
svg.text: One conversion across two sheets; their records keep different kinds of certainty.
MET COLLECTION RECORDS / BOTH IMAGE WINDOWS SHARE A PIXEL-TO-CENTIMETRE RATIO
Proportions follow the listed sheet dimensions; the screen does not preserve physical size.
